episode_event_salon_pasiosalon_date_ch00:
Hey, [Name:PlayerNickname ]!
Good timing!
I have a favor to ask.
Can you help me master Mega Evolution?
Sorry, that came out of the blue, didn’t it.
Let me explain.

As the successor, I’ve been teaching
everyone on Pasio how to use
Mega Evolution...

but I’ve been thinking I want to help people
learn even more about it.

As you probably know, Mega Evolution is
intricately linked to its user’s bonds.
So I figured this is your time to shine!

You’ve strengthened your bonds with many
people and Pokémon.

Making memories together, relying on one
another...
I’ve seen you get closer with everyone!

So I was hoping you’d share some tips,
[Name:PlayerNickname ].

That way, I could broaden Mega Evolution’s
horizons!
So...please!
Lend me your expertise!

(Laugh and say you’ll learn from
each other.)
Yeah! If I can teach you anything, I will!
Let’s become bond experts together!
(Say you’d be happy to.)
Really?! Thank you! I’m so glad!
All right! I’m all fired up!

I’m SO ready to learn about different kinds
of bonds!

Korrina and [Name:PlayerNickname ]
spent time together every day, teaching each
other about bonds.

I’ll be able to grow closer to so many more
people and Pokémon now.

Above all, I’m so happy we grew closer too,
[Name:PlayerNickname ]!
We gave it all we’ve got, didn’t we!

I wish people could Mega Evolve and power
up by deepening their connection to each
other.
Haha, I’m just messing around with you!

Still, I truly think Mega Evolution has that
potential!

Rather than see it only be used in Pokémon
battles...

I want to find new possibilities for it that can
make everyone happy!
(Say you want to find them, too.)

You really get me, huh! Glad we’re on the
same page!
(Say she’ll find the answer someday.)
Yeah! I think so, too!
Mega Evolution still has so many mysteries...

but learning from each other reminded me of
some things, [Name:PlayerNickname ].

First, I remembered the importance of taking
one’s time with bonds.

And I guess I remembered how well you
understand me!
*giggle* I hope we can keep hanging out!

Hey, I have an idea! Why don’t you try to
become the Mega Evolution successor too,
[Name:PlayerNickname ]?

I’m sure you can do it! When the time
comes...

we’ll fight for position of successor! It’ll be
a real battle using Mega Evolution—and the
power of bonds we learned from each other!
